title: Morning Mimosa and Swim 2hr Luxury Cruise in Marathon FL
blurb:
Experience a relaxing start to your day on a spacious 53’ luxury catamaran as you cruise through the clear waters surrounding Marathon. Enjoy a complimentary morning mimosa as the crew guides you along scenic coastlines with views of the Atlantic Ocean, Boot Key, and the iconic Seven Mile Bridge.
Take a refreshing swim in calm, shallow waters and explore the sandy bottom for shells and sea life. With plenty of space on board, comfortable seating, and friendly local crew, this tour offers a peaceful and memorable way to experience the beauty of the Florida Keys.
